turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no per-customer spend metric, so I can't name our best customer for September 2026. The closest figures are revenue of 12,582.75 EUR for 1 to 30 September 2026 and 10 active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) in that period. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
